verdict.rationale: Dialpad documents a public API with reference pages, a Python client library, and an llms.txt documentation index. However, no evidence shows a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent machine-readable spec, and probes of common OpenAPI/Swagger paths all returned 404. The llms.txt and markdown docs are adjacent documentation aids, not a machine-readable API specification.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
